title: ScoredResearchLibrary
description: Phase 23 / Stage 0 output of the Strategy Research Agent (Duty 2). A versioned, objective-trait-keyed bibliography of >=10 reputable publications, each scored on relevance/complexity/reliability/insightfulness, with extracted novel data/feature ideas. Extends the research_cases/papers/ corpus and feeds the Data Requirements Spec. Read-only research only.

objective_id.description: ID of the Trade Objective this library was gathered for.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the library was produced.

traits.description: Objective traits used to key this library for warm-start reuse on similar future objectives.

publications.description: At least 10 scored publications. A smaller set is a failed run.

id.description: Stable ID (e.g. arXiv id, DOI, or slug).

source_type.description: Reputable-source class the publication belongs to.

url.description: Canonical URL of the publication (read-only reference).

local_file.description: Optional path into research_cases/papers/ if a local summary was written.

relevance.description: Applicability to this product + strategy + horizon.

insightfulness.description: Degree to which it surfaces a novel data/feature type that could add edge.

summary.description: Concise extracted findings relevant to the objective.

data_feature_ideas.description: Novel data or feature types proposed by this publication; high-insight items fold back into the Data Requirements Spec.

notes.description: Free-form agent notes accumulated across objectives (append-mode library, ADR-025).

origin.description: How the entry arrived: pass_a | write_back | legacy (ADR-025 corpus write-back provenance).

added_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the entry was appended to the cumulative library.

indexed.description: True once the entry has been chunked+embedded into the scoping RAG index (scoping.research_chunks).
